meta.title: ART Lab — creative studio in Tallinn
meta.description: Creative classes for children and adults in Tallinn: art, creative workshops, handicrafts, masterclasses and birthday celebrations.

hero.description: ART Lab is a space where children and adults explore different creative directions and enjoy the process itself.
hero.imageAlt: A girl painting at an easel in the ART Lab creative studio

about.title: Creativity starts here.
about.intro: At ART Lab, we create an atmosphere that inspires people to imagine, experiment and express themselves.
about.description: During classes, children and adults explore different art materials and techniques. They learn to work with colour, form and composition while developing imagination, focus and creative thinking.
about.statement: For us, it is not only about teaching technique, but also helping everyone feel confident in their ideas and proud of what they create.
about.imageAlt: The bright ART Lab creative studio in Tallinn

directions.title: Find your direction.
directions.intro: Three formats with different personalities: focus on art, experiment freely or create something with your own hands.

art.title: Art classes
art.description: ART Lab's main direction. Each age group follows its own programme, from line, form and colour to composition, perspective, light and shade.
art.imageAlt: An art class at the ART Lab creative studio

creative.title: Creative workshop
creative.description: Draw, sculpt and make while exploring plasticine art, decoupage, appliqué, collage and mixed-media techniques.
creative.imageAlt: Children creating projects in the ART Lab creative workshop

handicraft.title: Handicraft club
handicraft.description: Explore macramé, beadwork, crochet and wool felting, moving from the first simple steps to a finished piece made by hand.
handicraft.imageAlt: A handicraft class at the ART Lab creative studio

celebrations.title: Important days become brighter.
celebrations.intro: Celebrate an important day creatively at ART Lab — in our welcoming studio or with an event at your chosen venue.
celebrations.formats: Children's and adult birthdays, family celebrations, hen parties, gatherings with friends and corporate events.
celebrations.description: We tailor the creative programme to the participants' ages, the number of guests and the format of your event.
celebrations.location: At our studio or at your chosen venue
celebrations.note: The studio provides all materials for the creative programme. The price depends on the selected masterclass, the number of participants and the event format.
celebrations.imageAlt: A creative celebration and masterclass at the ART Lab studio

workshops.title: Try what you have always wanted to.
workshops.description: ART Lab regularly hosts workshops for children and adults. Each time, we explore new themes, materials and techniques.
workshops.materials: All necessary materials are provided by the studio.

whyUs.title: A place where you can be yourself.

reasons.formats: Individual classes and groups of up to 6 participants
reasons.techniques: A wide variety of artistic and creative techniques
reasons.materials: All necessary materials are provided by the studio
reasons.beginners: No previous art experience is needed to begin
reasons.ages: Programmes for children of different ages and adults

whyUs.statementLead: ART Lab is about more than a beautiful result.
whyUs.statementAccent: It is a place where everyone learns to create, try something new and value their own ideas.
